mapper.insert: INSERT INTO after_sale_event (after_sale_id, operator_id, operator_role, operator_name, action, from_status, to_status, note) VALUES (#{afterSaleId}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorRole}, #{operatorName}, #{action}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT id, after_sale_id, operator_id, operator_role, operator_name, action, from_status, to_status, note, created_at FROM after_sale_event WHERE after_sale_id = #{afterSaleId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
